title: Regret-Oracle Complexity Tradeoffs in Agnostic Online Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.07155v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agnostic online learning is classically solved via a reduction to the realizable setting, utilizing Littlestone's Standard Optimal Algorithm (SOA) as a base learner. However, the SOA can be computationally intractable to implement even for a single round. To overcome this barrier, recent work in oracle-efficient online learning replaces the SOA with a realizable base learner that accesses the concept class exclusively through an offline empirical risk minimization (ERM) oracle. While such agnostic learners achieve expected regret $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt{T\cdot 2^{\mathcal{O}(d_{\mathrm{LD}})}}\big)$, which is near-optimal in the horizon $T$ for fixed Littlestone dimension $d_{\mathrm{LD}}$, they require $\mathcal{O}\big(T^{2^{\mathcal{O}(d_{\mathrm{LD}})}}\big)$ oracle calls. In this work, we significantly improve this oracle complexity while relying on an even weaker primitive: a weak-consistency oracle, which merely decides

translated_title: 不可知在线学习中遗憾值与Oracle复杂度的权衡
translated_abstract: 不可知在线学习经典地通过归约到可实现情形来解决，其基础学习器采用Littlestone的标准最优算法（SOA）。然而，SOA即使在单轮的实现上也可能在计算上难以处理。为了克服这一障碍，近期关于Oracle高效在线学习的工作用一种可实现的基础学习器替代了SOA，该学习器仅通过离线经验风险最小化（ERM）Oracle来访问概念类。虽然这类不可知学习器可以达到期望遗憾 $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}\big(\sqrt{T\cdot 2^{\mathcal{O}(d_{\mathrm{LD}})}}\big)$，在固定的Littlestone维数下关于时间范围 $T$ 接近最优，但它们需要 $\mathcal{O}\big(T^{2^{\mathcal{O}(d_{\mathrm{LD}})}}\big)$ 次Oracle调用。在本工作中，我们显著改进了这一Oracle复杂度，同时依赖一个更弱的原语：弱一致性Oracle，它仅需判断……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文显著改进了不可知在线学习中Oracle高效学习器的Oracle调用复杂度，且仅依赖更弱的弱一致性Oracle原语，实现了遗憾值与Oracle复杂度之间更优的权衡。
en_tdlr: This work significantly improves the oracle complexity of oracle-efficient agnostic online learning while relying on an even weaker weak-consistency oracle, achieving better tradeoffs between regret and oracle complexity.
